title: SIDESTORY: INVITATION TO WINE OPEN
lines: 01 SIDE STORY: INVITATION TO WINE OPEN
DETAILS: Invitation to Wine event stages will be open for a limited time. Players can obtain event rewards by clearing event stages, completing the event missions, and redeeming from the event shop.
UNLOCK REQUIREMENT: Clear Main Storyline 1-10
EVENT STAGES DURATION: Event Stages will open in 2 phases:
[Tales of Three-Mountains] Duration: July 29, 2022, 10:00 (UTC-7) – August 12, 2022, 03:59 (UTC-7)
[Mountain Top] Duration: August 05, 2022, 16:00 (UTC-7) – August 12, 2022, 03:59 (UTC-7)
[ESCORT DUTY]
DETAILS: During the event, players can complete "Escort Duty" missions by clearing event stages to gain rewards.
MAIN REWARDS: ★★★★★: Kroos the Keen Glint, Shan-Ch'eng Teahouse Furniture (Pieces), Canned Tea.
[XINGYU INN]
DURATION: July 29, 2022, 10:00 (UTC-7) – August 19, 2022, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: During the event, players can obtain Canned Tea by clearing event stages and [Escort Duty]. Canned Tea can be used to redeem items from [Xingyu Inn].
MAIN REWARDS: Kroos the Keen Glint’s Token, Shan-Ch'eng Teahouse Furniture (Pieces), Headhunting Permit, Elite Materials, LMD, Battle Records, Furniture Parts, etc.
During this event, the event stories cannot be reviewed in Public Affairs. After the event ends, the event stories will be recorded in Public Affairs.
02 LIMITED HEADHUNTING OPEN – UNSTRAINED LIQUOR, PELLUCID HEART
DURATION: July 29, 2022, 10:00 (UTC-7) – August 12, 2022, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: During the event, the Limited-time Headhunting, "Unstrained Liquor, Pellucid Heart", opens and the following Operators will appear at a higher rate from this Limited Headhunting:
★★★★★★: Ling (Limited) / Lee
★★★★★★: Nian (Limited) / Dusk (Limited)
★★★★★: Blacknight
NOTE:
[Unstrained Liquor, Pellucid Heart] is part of the [Limited Headhunting - Festival] headhunting series.
Operator Lee and Blacknight will be permanently added to other Standard Headhuntings in future update.
Operator Ling is currently ONLY available from the [Limited Headhunting - Festival], and is NOT available in any Standard Headhunting.
Operator Ling will not be available from any Limited Headhunting before January 01, 2023 after this Limited-time Headhunting.
Available Operators from [Limited Headhunting - Festival] headhunting series: Nian, Dusk, and Ling.
Operators from [Limited Headhunting - Festival] will be available again in future [Limited Headhunting - Festival].
Operators from [Limited Headhunting - Festival] may also be available from other Limited Headhunting.
Operators from [Limited Headhunting - Festival] may appear at a higher rate from future Limited Headhunting.
[LIMITED HEADHUNTING] DETAILS

During [Limited Headhunting] banners, if you do not get a 6-star Operator after 50 rolls, the probability of obtaining a 6-star Operator on the next roll will be increased from 2% to 4%. If you still do not roll a 6-star Operator, the probability of obtaining a 6-star Operator on the next roll will be further increased from 4% to 6%. This process repeats until a maximum probability of 100%, at which point you are guaranteed to receive a 6-star Operator.

The cumulative number of rolls that count towards this system will not carry over between different [Limited Headhunting] banners, and this number will be reset at the end of each [Limited Headhunting] banner. The increased probability of obtaining a 6-star Operator will also not be applied to any subsequent [Limited Headhunting] banners.

During [Limited Headhunting] banners, you will obtain 1 [Headhunting Data Contract] for each roll you perform. You will earn 10 [Headhunting Data Contracts] from doing 10-roll headhunting. You can use [Headhunting Data Contracts] in the [Headhunting Data Contract Shop] to exchange from a selection of Operators.
NOTE:

Any time you obtain a 6-star Operator during a [Limited Headhunting] banner, the next time you roll on that same [Limited Headhunting] banner, the probability of obtaining a 6-star Operator will be reset to 2%

Any [Headhunting Data Contracts] earned from previous [Limited Headhunting] banners will expire. After the current [Headhunting Data Contract Shop] closes, any unredeemed [Headhunting Data Contracts] will be converted into [Headhunting Parametric Models]. Each [Headhunting Data Contract] will be converted into 6 [Headhunting Parametric Models]. [Headhunting Parametric Models] have no expiration date, and can be used in the [Headhunting Parametric Model Shop] to exchange for designated items.

5 times weighted value means that the probability of obtaining [Nian [Limited] / Dusk [Limited]] increases, and decreases accordingly for other 6-star operators, until [Nian [Limited] / Dusk [Limited]] reaches 5 times the probability of obtaining other 6-star operators, aside from [Ling [Limited] / Lee].

DURATION: July 29, 2022, 10:00 (UTC-7) – August 12, 2022, 03:59 (UTC-7)

Sing while Drinking Headhunting Permit* 1
NOTE:

Sing while Drinking Headhunting Permit expires at: August 12, 2022, 03:59 (UTC-7)
Each account can only claim this reward once during the event.
04 LIMITED-TIME DAILY FREE ROLL EVENT OPEN
DURATION: July 29, 2022, 10:00 (UTC-7) – August 12, 2022, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: A free roll can be performed every day during the event in [Unstrained Liquor, Pellucid Heart] Limited Headhunting.
NOTE:
Daily Free Roll will be refreshed at 04:00 (UTC-7) every day.
The unused free roll chance will be refreshed each day and thus cannot be accumulated.
05 NEW OPERATORS AVAILABLE IN HEADHUNTING
★★★★★★: Ling [Limited]
★★★★★: Blacknight
DETAILS:
Operator Ling is currently ONLY available from the [Limited Headhunting - Festival], and is NOT available in any Standard Headhunting.
Operator Kroos the Keen Glint is currently ONLY available to be obtained from event Invitation to Wine, and is NOT available in any Standard Headhunting or Recruit.
Operator Lee and Blacknight will be permanently added to other Standard Headhuntings in future update.
Operator Ling, Lee, Blacknight, and Kroos the Keen Glint will gain more trust in the event stages.
06 LUNGMEN LUCKY STRIPS EVENT OPEN
DURATION: July 29, 2022, 10:00 (UTC-7) – August 12, 2022, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: During the event, players can get two trials for Lungmen Lucky Strips after daily login. Between the Lucky Stirps you picked, the one with the higher
amount of Orundum will be the final daily reward. Players need to use all trials to get the reward.
NOTE:
There are 14 days at most for players to pick Lucky Strips.
Players will randomly obtain following amount of Orundum from Lucky Strips:
Orundum * 200, Orundum * 300, Orundum * 400, Orundum * 500, Orundum * 600, Orundum * 800.

If the amount of Orundum in daily reward is less than 400 (400 is NOT included), players will be granted an extra trial the next day. The extra trial cannot be accumulated, players can get 3 daily trials at most (including the extra trial).
All the daily trials will be refreshed at 4:00 am on the next day and cannot be accumulated.

[RHODES ISLAND HEADHUNTING PACK]
DURATION: July 29, 2022, 10:00 (UTC-7) – August 19, 2022, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: Players need to select one of the following customized options when purchasing:
Type-α Headhunting Permit (Possible 6-star Operator ranged from: Surtr, Archetto, and Aak)
Type-β Headhunting Permit (Possible 6-star Operator ranged from: Mudrock, Eunectes, and Ceobe)
Type-γ Headhunting Permit (Possible 6-star Operator ranged from: Kal'tsit, Blemishine, and Mizuki)

After completing the customization and purchase, you will get the corresponding customization permit. Using the Headhunting Permit will perform a [Special Ten-roll Headhunting] and will randomly get one of the 6-star Operators appearing in the customization Headhunting Permit.
SPECIAL TEN-ROLL HEADHUNTING DETAILS :
You may select only one of the customization within this Special Headhunting Pack to purchase. It can only be purchased once and you cannot change your decision after purchasing.

This headhunting is part of [Special Ten-roll Headhunting]. When you headhunt in [Special Ten-roll Headhunting], rolls that do not give a 6-star Operator will not count towards the 6-star mechanism, nor will it affect your accumulated roll count in [Standard Headhunting]. The rate in this headhunting is not affected by your accumulated roll count in [Standard Headhunting] either.
When headhunting in [Special Ten-roll Headhunting], you are guaranteed to receive a 6-star Operator within 10 rolls. The available 6-star Operator depends on the customization chosen.
NOTE:
Expiration time of Special Ten-roll Headhunting Permit: September 16, 2022, 03:59 (UTC-7)
You may only use the Special Ten-roll Headhunting Permit once.
If not used by the expiration date, the Special Ten-roll Headhunting Permit will be removed from your Depot, so please make sure to use it before it expires.
